# Grocery Flywheel — ResonantOS add-on (local-first groceries)

Local-first, human-approves-everything groceries: it tracks what you bought,
notices what you've used, flags what's going stale, and drafts the next cart —
you say yes. The grocery-flywheel engine (MIT) is vendored byte-identical and
wrapped by a thin Python-standard-library-only local service. No accounts, no
cloud, no telemetry; nothing leaves your machine.

## Canonical links

- This repo: https://github.com/simongonzalezdc/resonant-grocery-flywheel
- Canonical upstream: https://github.com/simongonzalezdc/grocery-flywheel (MIT, HEAD 82da650 pinned)

## Key facts

- ResonantOS 2.0.0-alpha add-on; validator: 0 errors / 0 warnings
- License: MIT
- Wraps exactly the upstream MCP tools (analyze, dietary, sourcing, plan,
  dashboard) plus status; dietary checks are fail-closed — restrictions
  without current label evidence come back needs_review, never safe
- Checkout structurally cannot happen: checkout_available is false in the
  vendored engine, and an upstream test fails if that ever changes
- Zero capabilities requested; dashboards written only under var/dashboards/

Relationship: community gift by Kyanite Labs for ResonantOS — canonical
upstream: https://github.com/simongonzalezdc/grocery-flywheel; this wrapper is
non-canonical; where anything here disagrees with the canonical upstream, the
canonical upstream wins.
